answer_1.quote: We tackle 5 applications. (i) Grammar Correction (GC): to generate the correct form of a given input containing grammar errors. (ii) Smart Reply (SR): to generate a response to a given textual message. (iii) Text Summarization (TS): to generate a shorter version of a given sentence. (iv) Tone Adjustment (TA): to re-write a given text in a specific style. (iv) Question Answering (QA): to answer a given question.
answer_1.outputs: generated text outputs for grammar correction, smart reply, text summarization, tone adjustment, and question answering

answer_2.quote: Following the literature, we report F05 (↑) for GC, Weighted Rouge (↑) for SR, RougeL (↑) for TS and TA, and F1 (↑) for QA.
